footnote_text: On October 5, 2026, the reporting person entered into an agreement (the "Contribution Agreement") relating to the transfer of a contribution to the charter fund of the reporting person, with Mr. Jakhongir Abidovich Artikkhodjaev, an individual who owns substantially all of the interests in the reporting person. Pursuant to the Contribution Agreement, Mr. Artikkhodjaev transferred 1,000,000 shares of common stock of the Company to the reporting person for an aggregate price of US$138,268 (US$0.138 per share). The transfer closed on October 5, 2026.
